instruction: Tap the center top button of the alarm-clock with large numbers

source.instruction: Tap the center top button of the alarm-clock with large numbers

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the alarm, which was at x = -24 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm to (-24, -8.5, 95) and orient pointing down over the center button.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+6, +10, +1) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +21 cm (vertical) from the alarm

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, -9, 95) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close left gripper to 0.00 to form a tapping point.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +21 cm (vertical) from the alarm; closed the gripper (opening 0.00: nothing held)

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, -9, 95) opening 0.00; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper downward by 3 cm to z=92 to press the center button.
